objective: Take the Blue-feathered Necklace to Trull Failbane at Bloodvenom Post.
start: Dropped by Crazed Owlbeast, Moontouched Owlbeast and 1 more in Winterspring

description: You are unsure of the significance of the necklace that fell from the neck of the recently-slain wildkin. It glows brightly, slowly fading in and out.
Trull Failbane might be able to tell you more, since his knowledge of the wildkin seems extensive. Perhaps you should ask him about it.
